### Fixed

- (ui-react) [Set an autosized textarea's height outside its ResizeObserver callback](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3500) by [@marians](https://github.com/marians) — Resizing the window while the New session dialog or a session's message box holds a long prompt no longer reports a `ResizeObserver loop` browser error; the field's height follows one frame later.
